To find the answers, let's break down the calculations:

1. **Total wall length**: $30 + 20 + 14 + 16 + 16 + 36 = 132\text{ ft}$.
2. **Wall area**: $132\text{ ft} \times 8\text{ ft} = 1056\text{ sq ft}$.
3. **Number of CMUs without waste**: 
   - Length in courses: $132\text{ ft} \times (12\text{ in} / 16\text{ in}) = 99\text{ blocks per course}$
   - Height in courses: $8\text{ ft} \times (12\text{ in} / 8\text{ in}) = 12\text{ courses}$
   - Total CMUs = $99 \times 12 = 1188\text{ blocks}$.
4. **CMUs with 3% waste**: $1188 \times 1.03 = 1223.64$, rounded up to 1224 CMUs.
5. **Grout (fully grouted)**: Total CMU count = $1584$ blocks. Volume = $1584 \times 0.17\text{ ft}^3 \times 1.10 / 27 = 10.97\text{ CY}$.
6. **Grout (at 32 in o.c.)**: Spacing of 32 in means every 2nd cell is grouted (since cells are every 16 in), so half of the blocks ($1584 / 2 = 792$) have vertical reinforcement. Volume = $792 \times 0.17\text{ ft}^3 \times 1.10 / 27 = 5.49\text{ CY}$.

FINAL: Q1 = 1224 CMU
FINAL: Q2 = 10.97 CY
FINAL: Q3 = 5.49 CY
